name: geonovum-mim
description: Two plugins, one shared MIM reading core. geonovum-mim-interpret: interpret any MIM-conformant model so agents can answer questions about the data those models describe more correctly and more efficiently. mim-core: how to read MIM, fetch RDF/catalogus, element summaries. geonovum-mim-implement is a stub (implement a model in software; not built). Consume-only interpret skill: not for authoring or validating models.
